description: Simulated satellite EPS fault-diagnosis dataset (SA/BAT/PCU/BUS/LOAD graph, one full-orbit window per sample).

feature_notes.soc: State of charge in [0,1]; only physically meaningful for the BAT node, zero-filled for SA/PCU/BUS/LOAD.

normalization.method: z-score per (node, feature), computed on TRAIN split only
